svg.title: Login page - ControlEasy Reborn
svg.desc: Login page showing centered card with email/password/remember-me/sign-in, error states, tenant picker, and session-expired toast. Three responsive breakpoints in both light and dark themes.
svg.text: Centered card, max-w-md (28rem = 448px), viewport bg var(--color-background) #f8fafc, card bg var(--color-surface-elevated) #ffffff

g.text: By signing in, you agree to our Terms of Service.

Components: ce-card, ce-input x2, ce-button (primary, lg, type=submit), ce-checkbox, ce-badge (error states). Route: /login (outside AppShell). Auth flow: POST /api/v1/auth/login. Skip-link targets main#login. Theme toggle: fixed top-right, uses ThemeService.

svg.text: 401 error: badge tone=danger, password aria-invalid, focus returns to email field.

g.text: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.

svg.text: 429 error: badge tone=warning, sign-in button disabled for Retry-After duration.
After successful login with >1 tenant, the card transitions to a tenant picker. 2-column grid on md+.

g.text: You belong to multiple tenants. Choose one to continue.
Tenant picker: 2-column grid on md+. Each card is ce-card accent=primary. Clicking calls POST /api/v1/security/tenant-switch. If only 1 tenant, picker is skipped. Transition: 200ms fade.

svg.text: Card fills viewport width with mx-4 (16px) padding. Brand mark h-8 (32px). All touch targets ≥ 44x44px.
Mobile: card fills width (mx-4 = 16px padding each side). Brand mark h-8 (32px). All interactive targets ≥ 44x44px. Inputs have 44px height. Checkbox tap target padded to 44x44.
Card bg var(--color-surface-elevated) #1f2937, viewport bg var(--color-background) #0b1020, inset border for contrast

g.text: By signing in, you agree to our Terms of Service.

svg.text: Card centered at max-w-md. Brand mark h-12 (48px). Same layout as desktop but slightly narrower.

g.text: All screens composed of design-system components only. Backend: POST /api/v1/auth/login, GET /api/v1/security/tenants?email=..., POST /api/v1/security/tenant-switch. Auth: JWT with sub, tenant_id, profile_id, roles[], permissions[]. A11y: skip-link to #login, aria-live=assertive for errors, focus management after error/login.
